task: Creating a quick washi tape design on paper
query: How do I create a quick washi tape design on paper?

goal.title: Draw a face on a patterned tape panel
goal.description: Align strips of patterned adhesive tape across a white sheet, trim the excess, then draw a face on the taped area with a green marker and display it.
goal.final_state: A green face is visible on a rectangular panel of patterned tape adhered to the white paper. The paper is displayed and then returned toward the desk.

procedure.description: Clear space on the desk, center the white paper and place the semicircular protractor across it. Retrieve and uncap the green marker, hold the protractor against the paper and draw a horizontal line along its straight edge. Move the protractor below the line.

Put the marker aside and take the patterned adhesive tape roll. Spend several attempts locating and lifting its edge, pull a strip across the paper to gauge its length, then cut it with scissors. Put the scissors down and move the protractor and roll out of the working area. Straighten the loose strip, align it with the guideline, lower it onto the paper and smooth it flat.

Unroll and cut a second strip. Set the roll aside, straighten the curling strip and align it adjacent to the first. Press it onto the paper, lift the sheet to inspect, then use scissors to trim the tape extending beyond each paper edge. Rotate the sheet between cuts, peel away the offcuts and attach them to the front edge of the desk. Lay the paper down and press the strips flat.

Take the roll again, pull out a third strip, raise it and cut across it. Set the roll aside, straighten the cut strip, carefully align it above the existing tape and smooth it down. Lift the paper edge, trim the projecting tape and remove the offcut to the desk front before lowering the scissors.

Pull out and cut a fourth strip of the same tape. Straighten it, align it beside the other strips and press it onto the paper to widen the patterned panel. Lift and rotate the sheet to trim both projecting ends, peel away the offcuts and press the completed tape panel flat.

Retrieve the green marker and draw a large oval outline across the taped area while the other hand steadies the sheet. Add two eyes, a central nose and a wide rectangular mouth. Retrace the eyes and add short lines around the mouth. The left fingers press the supported paper rather than lifting it during drawing.

Move the cap from the back of the marker onto its tip using both hands and set the capped marker beside the marker box. Lift the paper with both hands to display the face drawn on the patterned tape panel. After the final human fine boundary at 342.7s the sheet continues to be displayed and is lowered onto the desk near the end; no additional drawing is visible.

coarse.instruction: Draw a guideline on the paper
coarse.description: Move tools aside, center the paper, position a protractor, retrieve and uncap the marker, draw a horizontal line along its straight edge and shift the protractor downward.
coarse.goal_contribution: Establishes an alignment reference for the patterned tape panel.

coarse.instruction: Cover the paper with aligned patterned tape strips
coarse.description: Locate the roll edge, pull and cut four strips in successive cycles, straighten each strip and press it beside the previous one. Move tools aside as needed, lift and rotate the sheet to trim projecting tape, discard offcuts onto the desk front and smooth the completed panel.
coarse.goal_contribution: Builds the continuous patterned surface on which the face will be drawn.
coarse.predictability_reason: After a paper guideline, laying patterned tape is plausible but not directly necessary for drawing.

coarse.instruction: Draw and display the face on the tape
coarse.description: Retrieve the green marker, draw an oval outline, eyes, nose and wide mouth on the tape, retrace facial details, cap and set down the marker, then lift the sheet for display.
coarse.goal_contribution: Produces and presents the completed face drawing on the taped paper.
coarse.predictability_reason: The patterned tape panel is ready for the stated face drawing.
